description: A bank-level register for every Russian bank covering registration, licence revocation, liquidation, location changes, acquisitions, entry to and exit from the Deposit Insurance System, and state and foreign ownership. The DataCite record says the data come from open online sources. The Mendeley Data record by Alexei Karas is at version 2, published on 31 July 2020, with one Excel file (karver2019.xlsx) of about 0.4 MB, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the Russian banking sector; the years covered and variable definitions are not stated on the page read, so they must be taken from the file. Caveats: it is a single-author compilation last updated in 2020, before the sanctions and bank licence changes after 2022, and ownership codes are researcher judgements. For simulation it gives the population and failure history of banks in a system with many licence revocations, to calibrate bank failure rates, deposit insurance payouts and consolidation in financial network models. Related catalogue records include the FDIC BankFind Suite for United States banks.
